title: recent signal
description: Recently played tracks: a local history the server records from nowPlaying on each track change (needs providers.now_playing too), persisted in ~/Library/Caches/orbit-desktop. GET /api/signals/recent, polled every 10 s; 404 unless providers.recent.enabled. No network. SENSITIVE (listening history).

items.description: Newest first, distinct consecutive tracks, at most providers.recent.max_items.

at.description: When it started playing. Unix time in seconds (float).
